_comment: 20-epoch smoke of the n=50 W6 stride arm at the DEFAULT rank-gate tolerance.
Its only job is to produce THIS config's own network_estimability.csv, because the
rank_gate_tol placement rule is per-config: >= 2 decades above that config's gauge
depth and >= 2 below its weakest real layer.  The 1e-12 that worked on the 50-station
INT fixture was placed from a DIFFERENT spectrum (different stations, no injected OSB)
and must not be carried over on faith.
